title: The Proposed Changes in Childhood Vaccination: A Strongly Felt Opinion
body_text: Let’s talk a bit about the Executive Order on the administration of childhood vaccines. But let me make it clear up front: I am not going to do the president the favor of taking his arguments seriously and doing any sort of point-by-point refutation. That’s because the premise of the whole thing is that there is something about childhood vaccination - and the MMR shot in particular - that Trump believes has caused an “autism epidemic”. There is no such connection, not least because as far as anyone can tell there is no such epidemic. And numerous, numerous attempts have been made to search through the medical data to look for such a link, with no success at all. This has been an effort spanning many countries and many researchers and vast numbers of patient records, and no such link has ever been shown to exist. Over and over and over. And the reason that all this got going was fraudulent in the first place. The physician who started the whole MMR/autism controversy, Andrew Wakefield, had his license to practice stripped in the UK because the entire claim turned out to be knowingly false. The original paper itself was retracted - no one had been able to reproduce his findings even before that, and it turned out that Wakefield had an undisclosed financial interest in selling test kits as a result of its publication. The British General Medical Council found that Wakefield had lied during the publication process and had mistreated children and acted against their best interests. So the whole thing is a lie and no truth has ever been found in it despite a very large expenditure of time and money. People who tell you otherwise - like President Trump and his Secretary of Health and Human Services, RFK Jr., are at best grievously misinformed or simply lying to you for their own benefit. My opinion on that versus Kennedy is a matter of record already. I must say, though, Trump is so erratic and disconnected from reality that it’s really hard to tell what he believes from one minute to the next. Here is a direct quote from his announcement yesterday: ”I have seen proof of where they have a vaccination thing that looks like the size of a bottle of soda and pour it into a little child’s body”. This is deranged nonsense, expressed in the words of someone whose cerebral cortex is shedding vocabulary by the day - “vaccination thing”, really? A brief reminder: this man not only imagines that he is making medical policy, but he also has the nuclear launch codes and that part is unfortunately no delusion. I say “imagine he’s making medical policy”, because (despite what some headlines might have you believe), an Executive Order is not an instant law, or a royal decree, or a thunderbolt launched from the throne of Zeus. It is a memo to agencies in the Executive Branch on how the President believes that a given policy should be implemented. Now, HHS (and the NIH, CDC et al.) are indeed in the Executive Branch, so they have to listen to this garbage. But physicians do not. This is not a new law, and no one will be breaking the law if they instead follow the vaccination schedule laid out by the American Academy of Pediatrics. There are in fact many states that have publicly rejected the CDC’s stated vaccination schedule in favor of the AAP’s, and this latest nonsense is reason for many more to join them. And besides, this executive order not only calls for fewer shots and fewer diseased to be immunized against, it calls for vaccines that don’t even exist here. Trump apparently thinks that the MMR vaccine can somehow be split up into its component parts, but there are no such individual vaccines licensed for use in the US. Stat reports that the makers of the MMR vaccine itself are showing no interest at all in producing and testing these components separately, and good for them. And again, this EO does not force them to do so in any way whatsoever. It’s a painfully stupid idea and the potential disruption it could cause in childhood vaccine schedules is going to make more children sick and inevitably kill some of them along the way. All these Executive Order noises seem to be a show put on for people who are already unsure about childhood vaccination (or who are downright opposed to it), and catering to these points of view is going to lead to an upsurge in disease and an upsurge in the sale of extra-small coffins. We are being governed by ignorant, malevolent fools who are leaving death and destruction in their wake. I can’t put it any more plainly than that.
